name: Trinity Lofts (Live/Work Split-Level)
price: $2,350-$2,450/mo (split-level lofts, prior listing) up to $3,600-$5,032/mo (true storefront live/work suites)
notes: Jim Lake Co. building, 93 units. Dual-story units: ground-floor retail/office + garage w/ storefront entrance, 1BR/1BA above. Designed for galleries/creative studios. Storefront suites $3,600+ exceed $3,500 cap but qualify as documented exception (true storefront + explicit live/work + customer parking). Split-level residential lofts 1857-2153 sqft at $2,350-$2,450 are under cap but slightly over sqft target. VERIFY current ceiling height + active unit pricing with Jim Lake Co / trinityloft.com.

name: Bishop Arts Live/Work Lofts (#422)
address: Bishop Arts District, Oak Cliff, Dallas, TX 75208
notes: First-floor retail live/work units: street-facing retail entrance for customers + rear resident door. Explicitly zoned to run a small business (use restrictions apply). Units 540-1150 sqft; MOST are ~550 sqft so must target the 1,000-1,150 sqft units. Contact 214-233-6455. VERIFY 1BR layout, ceiling height, current availability of the larger units.

name: Expo Park Lofts (Paper Mill / B.F. Goodrich / GMC Building)
address: Exposition Park, ~800-900 blocks 1st Ave / Exposition Ave, Dallas, TX 75226
notes: Historic industrial conversions (Paper Mill 1929, B.F. Goodrich tire factory 1926, GMC truck storefront). Self-described 'most unique live/work space in Dallas'; already houses art galleries & photography studios. ~39 loft units in neighborhood. Managed by August Real Estate (augustrealestate.com/expo-park). Site blocks automated fetch -- CALL to confirm price, sqft, ceiling, 1BR availability.

name: South Side on Lamar
notes: Historic Sears warehouse conversion. Open plans, exposed brick, big windows. Building has on-site retail, 'artist quarters,' and a rotating art gallery -- arts-tolerant culture. 1BR 1062-2558 sqft fits target. Units are upper-floor residential (no private storefront). Confirm with leasing whether in-unit client visits / studio work is permitted by lease.

name: Interurban Building
notes: 1916 train-station conversion, 134 true lofts. CONFIRMED 11-15 ft ceilings, exposed brick, concrete floors, big windows -- best authentic loft + ceiling height in the set. Sample 1BR is only 661 sqft (below target); larger 1BR units exist near top of range (some >$3,500 -- reject those over cap). Residential building, no storefront. Confirm client/studio policy.

name: Adam Hats Lofts
notes: Historic Ford assembly plant. ~8 units available at search time. Vaulted ceilings, polished concrete floors, split-level + exposed beam interiors. Floor plans labeled 'studio' 580-1556 sqft (open-plan, sleeping area definable -> acceptable convertible). Look-and-lease special active. Deep Ellum mixed-use; residential lease (work use tolerated, not zoned). Confirm ceiling number + client policy.

name: Deep Ellum Lofts (Murray / Continental / Farm & Ranch)
notes: Westdale-managed trio of historic Deep Ellum loft buildings. Vaulted ceilings, polished concrete, split-level, exposed beams. 3 units available at search time; floor plans 580-2,425 sqft. Leasing (469) 609-6944. Residential; confirm work/client policy + ceiling height.

name: The Davis Building (The Drakestone)
notes: 1926 Republic National Bank, 20-story, 183 loft-style units. 1BR 578-2,008 sqft. High-rise residential -- foot-traffic/gallery use impractical from upper floors; clients tolerated at best. Strong budget + loft aesthetic. Confirm ceiling height + lease rules on commercial activity.

name: SoCo Urban Lofts
notes: Historic 203-unit CONDO building (former Santa Fe Terminal), exposed brick, period detail. 7 rental units at search time, min rent $1,750. CONDO HOA likely restricts commercial activity/signage/foot traffic -- pull the HOA covenants before considering for gallery use. Good for live+studio; gallery storefront risk is high.

name: @15th
address: 15th Street, Downtown Plano Historic Arts District, Plano, TX 75074
notes: 52 newly constructed 1BR apartments in the Downtown Plano Arts District, walkable to galleries/DART. NEW construction -- not industrial loft; confirm open plan + ceiling height. Plano allows live/work in the downtown/central district with street-level work component. Contact (214) 521-0042. Better as residence near arts scene than as true loft/storefront.

name: 15th Street Village
address: Downtown Plano, 15th St corridor, Plano, TX 75074
notes: Condo loft-conversion units, for sale and rent, in heart of Downtown Plano within walking distance of dining/shops. Live/work potential given arts-district location + Plano downtown zoning. Verify unit specifics, HOA commercial rules, ceiling height via DFW Urban Realty.

name: MAA Addison Circle
notes: Loft-STYLING only (floor-to-ceiling windows, industrial finishes) in walkable Addison Circle mixed-use district -- but a conventional managed apartment community. Standard residential lease almost certainly prohibits client foot traffic / commercial use. Included only as a loft-aesthetic fallback; NOT a true live/work option.

name: Frisco Station Lofts
address: Historic Frisco Railroad Station, Frisco, TX
notes: 1913 Frisco Railroad Station renovated to 57 loft units. Authentic historic conversion. Far north of the core corridor -- include only if a Frisco location is acceptable. Confirm ceiling, 1BR specs, and any work/client policy.

name: Downtown Carrollton Lofts
address: Historic Downtown Carrollton Square, Carrollton, TX
notes: Walkable historic square w/ shops, restaurants, weekly farmers market + DART Green Line. Mix of loft conversions and live/work storefront inventory (also on LoopNet). Strong value + storefront potential; verify specific 1BR loft units, ceiling height, and small-business zoning at the square.

name: Continental Gin Building
notes: FORMER artist-studio loft building (1888); displaced its artists and reopened ~2021 as OFFICE / coworking spec suites (1,000-5,000 sqft, Common Desk). No residential component now -> fails the 'live' half of live/work. Listed for transparency; studio/gallery-only use possible but you cannot legally reside there. Reject for live/work.
